engine: Springs Wellness amenity menu (Spa/Yoga/Fitness/Café) — list-index <-> (media+copy) binding, click-driven, with a vertical push media swap. Harvested from D_springs_wellness_menu_clip.

measured_teardown.layout: SPLIT — media LEFT (hard rectangle window, ~0->50%), persistent serif INDEX + body copy RIGHT. media is the only thing that changes per step.
measured_teardown.index: 4 serif words right-aligned, FIXED y-positions (never move); active bright cream (~1.0), rest dimmed (~0.35). Only the highlight changes — no carousel/focal-line.
measured_teardown.drive: CLICK-driven (list words are buttons; pointer cursor; hover does NOT swap), NOT scroll-jacked. The label LEADS — it lights instantly on click, then media + copy follow. Section is PINNED during interaction (header/list/glow stay put).
measured_teardown.media_swap: VERTICAL PUSH (not crossfade): a 2-layer stack translateY's by one frame-height — old exits UP, new enters from BELOW (incoming translateY 100%->0, outgoing 0->-100%, moved together). ~0.5-0.65s eased. No clip-path, no wipe, no ghosting.
measured_teardown.copy: 4-6 lines, bottom-anchored bottom-right (grows upward); fades out -> swaps -> fades+rises in, a beat after the media.
measured_teardown.glow: a CONSTANT radial gradient on the right column (teal core lower-left ~#0E2E2C -> forest edge ~#16291E) behind the copy. NEVER changes between steps = cohesion (the 'luxury' work on the text side, replacing Ever's oval).

copyDelayMs.what: delay before the copy swap (a beat after the media starts).

binding: ONE activeIndex drives three things in lockstep: (a) which label is lit, (b) which media rides the top of the push stack, (c) which copy shows.
entry: PersistentIndexMenu.init(target, opts) -> { go(i), current(), items }. Markup-first: .pim-item children carry data-label/media/copy; engine builds the 2-layer push stack, the index buttons, drives copy. Arrow up/down also cycles (accessible).
law: transform (media push) + opacity (index dim, copy) only; GPU layers; the glow is a STATIC CSS gradient (never animated over a moving surface); NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the moving media; reduced-motion -> hard swap (no push); click + keyboard driven. NO WebGL.
vs_media_step_switch: the award-rhythm upgrade of media-step-switch: split (index always visible) + vertical push (one transform, cleaner than a seam-wipe) + click-driven+pinned (jump non-linearly, no wheel-jack, accessible) + constant glow (cohesion) + fixed binary-opacity active state.
gate_mode: CURTAIN/SLICER (CURTAIN=1): the push shows two media layers during the swap = the technique; blank/jank/fps stay hard.
proven: lab: OUR amenities — Двір / Тераса / Паркінг / Кафе — on our renders + Ukrainian copy. Click Тераса: label leads (Двір 0.43->dim, Тераса 0.91->lit mid-push), media push (layerA -635 up, layerB 265 from below), copy swapped to 'Власна тераса над дахами', glow constant. window.__LAB_OK__ set.
